message.content:
1) **Yes**, the dialog panel is fully opaque. The underlying page content (cards, text, icons) is completely obscured by the dark background of the dialog panel, with no bleed-through or transparency visible.

2) **Yes**, all `kbd` key chips and text are legible. There is no clipping or overlapping of elements within the dialog. All key labels (`?`, `Esc`, `Tab`, `D`, `M`, `P`, `C`, `Scroll`, `Pinch`, `Drag`, `Double-click`) are clearly rendered with proper padding, and the associated descriptive text is well-spaced and fully readable.

3) **9/10**. The UI is highly polished with excellent typography hierarchy, consistent spacing, and a clean dark theme aesthetic. 
*   **Defects observed:** None. The layout is solid, the contrast is appropriate for a dark theme, and the visual design of the "key" chips is professional. The only minor point for improvement would be ensuring the bottom-most text ("The home page is six tool cards...") has slightly more bottom padding to match the top padding, but it is not clipped in this view.
